answer: Farming becomes a nectar bet on surviving 94 epochs of grading, and every gale settlement recomputes the mesa schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 94 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 2 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
